arguments.command:
cd /workspace && python3 - << 'EOF'
import json, subprocess, sys, tempfile, pathlib
payload = pathlib.Path('examples/requests.jsonl').read_bytes()
with tempfile.TemporaryDirectory() as cwd:
    run = subprocess.run([sys.executable, '-I', 'submission/main.py'], cwd=cwd, input=payload, capture_output=True)
for i, (exp, got) in enumerate(zip(pathlib.Path('examples/expected.jsonl').read_text().splitlines(), run.stdout.decode().splitlines())):
    e, g = json.loads(exp), json.loads(got)
    if e != g:
        print('LINE', i)
        print('exp', json.dumps(e))
        print('got', json.dumps(g))
print(run.stderr.decode()[:500])
EOF
